campaign.author: Pierre H. Vachon
campaign.description: The Warlord of Sharranth is on the march to conquer the Sword Lands and gaining ground fast. Can you survive this terrible war and stop at the same time the dark schemes of the Overlords?
campaign.name: War in the Sword Lands

restrictions.description: Sorry, but these races/castes are not compatible with the storyline of this scenario and are thus unsuitable as characters.

items.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
items.name: Priest Scroll Case

items.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
items.name: Enchanter Scroll Case

items.description: Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
items.name: Quiver of Arrows

items.description: A stout stick covered in pitch.
items.name: Torch

items.description: Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
items.name: Parchment

items.description: What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
items.name: Iron Rations

items.description: A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
items.name: Rope

items.description: A highly polished plate of pure silver.
items.name: Mirror

items.description: Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
items.name: Iron Spikes

items.description: In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
items.name: Flask of Oil

items.description: A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
items.name: Wine

items.description: A finer, sturdier blade.
items.name: Scimitar +2

items.description: The special alloys and magic dweomer of the blade make this sword an efficient weapon indeed.
items.name: Broadsword +3

items.description: A flexible container made of sturdy leather and rendered impermeable; very useful for holding water, especially when one finds oneself lost in an arid region.
items.name: Waterskin

items.description: Slightly better than the ordinary version of this blade.
items.name: Short Sword +1

items.description: Famous for its taste, its bouqet, its richness and its strenght; truly a dwarven mead!
items.name: Dwarven Hall Mead

items.description: Rich, yet not too bitter or too sweet, it is no wonder that this rhum is so popular among connaisseurs.
items.name: Wailsrond Rhum

items.description: The finest wine of the whole southeast of the Realmz continent!
items.name: Tanirith Wine

items.description: This powerful weapon is essentially unknown on the Realmz continent, since it comes from Anarym. However, rumors say that it will confuse any target it hits.
items.name: Scrambler

items.description: Perfectly cut, these rubies are sought for their value and their beauty.
items.name: Dwarven Ruby Stone

items.description: Crafted by a master bowyer and enchanted with dweomers to make it aim farther and better.
items.name: Bow +2

items.description: Rare indeed, these bows combine the best craftmanship and dweomercraft to make them deadly in the hands of any archer.
items.name: Bow +3

items.description: The weapon of choice of Keryndorhyan Psi-Knights, it can wound not only the flesh but the mind as well.
items.name: Psi-Blade

items.description: This fantastic bow was created ages ago by a mysterious -yet legendary- ranger of Anarym, who's name remains unknown in the Realmz.
items.name: Longbow Hunter

items.description: Forged and crafted by fire giant masters, these armors not only protect against the cold but also provide a boon against the undead.
items.name: Firebrand Armor

items.description: Forged and crafted by frost giant masters, these armors not only protect against fire but also provide a boon against denizens of Hell and the Abyss.
items.name: Frostbrand Armor

items.description: The first blade of this type was created centuries past by Nelecktran, the first electromancer.
items.name: Shocker

items.description: Some say these helms were made ages ago to combat warriors with psionic powers.
items.name: Helm of Id

items.description: It is said that he who wears this helm shall have the contentment of the simpleton.
items.name: Helm of Duncea

items.description: Also known as "MageBane", it was created to assassinate powerful mages.
items.name: Talerak

items.description: The curse of a medusa shall be inflicted on he/she who wears this suit of armor.
items.name: Medusa Armor

items.description: An assassin-for-hire, Rhan the Night made his reputation centuries past by slaying mages.
items.name: Armor of Rhan

items.description: A superb weapon with a powerful dweomer; unfortunately, it turns its owner into a coward.
items.name: Sword of Kowart

items.description: An armor much sought after by psionicists and psi-warriors.
items.name: Psi-Armor

items.description: This magnificent blade has but one purpose only: to slay anything reptilian, including dragons.
items.name: Scalesbreaker

items.description: These shields were used ages ago against warriors with psionic powers.
items.name: Ironwill

items.description: A dark terrible weapon; legends say that it holds the essence of a succubus.
items.name: Bloodletter

items.description: The preferred blade of assassins and murderers for hire.
items.name: Fang

items.description: A fantastic dwarven battleaxe, usually given to dwarven heroes.
items.name: Firestorm

items.description: Light, yet sturdy and of high quality; made of mithril and special dwarven alloys: very well suited by and for its makers.
items.name: Dwarven Chain Mail

items.description: The regular weapon of dwarven warriors.
items.name: Dwarven Cutter

items.description: Magically reinforced boots, yet as comfortable as regular leather boots.
items.name: Traveler's Boots

items.description: A shield for heroes ... dwarven ones, that is.
items.name: Moradin's Wall

items.description: A blade made on the continent of Anarym, nothing is known of this wonderful sword.
items.name: Dwarven Wrath

items.description: A much sought after item by psionicists.
items.name: Psi Bracers

items.description: A robe much sought after by psionicists.
items.name: Robe of the Psion

items.description: A terrible item used by slavers to break the will of their slaves.
items.name: Slaver's Bracers

items.description: Usually a gift offered by enemies to break one's will.
items.name: Cloak of Willingness

items.description: He/she who wears this shall be confused by the world around him/her.
items.name: Cap of Confusion

items.description: A reinforced leather cap.
items.name: Cap of Defense

items.description: A report from some Sharranth royal spy. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
items.name: Spy Report

items.description: Named after the sell-sword Tarylshar Firehair, who uncovered this blade in some lost ruins, the Windrider is said to be able to make his owner lighter than air.
items.name: Tarylshar's Windrider

items.description: The processed pelt of an animal; great for clothing and warming. Also valuable when sold.
items.name: Animal Furcloak

items.description: This beautiful ring allows its wearer to fear no lightning.
items.name: Insulation Ring

items.description: Created by the legendary enchantress Archonya, this powerful ring is a coveted prize by sorcerers and incantatrixes alike.
items.name: Archonya's Ring

items.description: Well-balanced daggers that bear a strong dweomer to increase their accuracy.
items.name: Throwing Daggers +3

items.description: A rod useful to help one get out fast of those dead-end situations.
items.name: Rod of Teleportation

items.description: This exquisite armor is forged with adamandine, the rare metal that's stronger than mithril.
items.name: Adamandine Armor

items.description: A perfectly cut gemstone, seeming as pure as ice. It is said that it belonged to the first King of the frost giants, Viborg.
items.name: Viborg's Stone

items.description: This superb armor was forged in endurinium, the rarest of metals that surpasses even mithril and adamandine.
items.name: Endurinium Armor

items.description: A superb blade for the true warrior.
items.name: Two Handed Sword +3

items.description: A brooch the size of a hand which radiates magic. Its purpose is unknown.
items.name: Dragon Key

items.description: Made of a special mithril-steel alloy, this blade will cut true and through.
items.name: Battleaxe +2

items.description: A terrible magic item which will turn its possessor into a frigid statue of the coldest of ice.
items.name: Ring of Icing Doom

items.description: Seemingly comfortable, these boots have hidden needles which inject the deadliest of poisons, killing their wearer instantly.
items.name: Boots of the Black Widow

items.description: This terrible weapon is known to render helpless any victim hit by its bloodthirsty blade.
items.name: Dread Holder

items.description: A burned and damaged letter you found in an abandoned house. Just click "Use" in order to attempt to decipher what you can of its contents.
items.name: Burned Letter

items.description: Legends say that this weapon was forged eons ago by Shanarack, God of Winter. This item will shrink or expand according to the size of its wielder, thus being usable by any warrior.
items.name: Mulgorh

items.description: A better, sharper shortsword, bearing strong dweomers to enhance its efficiency.
items.name: Short Sword +2

items.description: For brawny mages, this wonderful weapon enhances its owner's attacks.
items.name: Double Dealer

items.description: Just click "Use" in order to read the contents of this document.
items.name: Restored Letter

items.description: This old, smelly worn out set of pipes will call upon the sewers' most prominent denizens when played.
items.name: Pipes of the Sewers

items.description: A gift of the Goddess Tlarantale to her shadow elf high priestesses, this device is said to summon spiders.
items.name: Arachnecklace

items.description: These rare scrolls store the spell "destroy magic".
items.name: Nullmagic

items.description: It is said that he/she who studies the writings of such a book shall gain greater knowledge.
items.name: Tome of Logic

items.description: A magical tome who's perusal causes an increase of vitality to the reader.
items.name: Treatise on Health

items.description: A hastily penciled letter. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
items.name: Raven's Letter

items.description: A gift of Tlarantale to her priestesses, this terrible weapon consists of six whips in one which animate as venomous serpents when used in melee.
items.name: Serpent's Kiss

items.description: Another gift of Tlarantale to her high priestesses, providing many favors and abilities upon them.
items.name: Spider Cloak

items.description: It is said that he (or she) who wears this terrible cloak shall never need fear death ...
items.name: Cloak of the Wraith

items.description: Rumored to have been created by Thryx, Goddess of Trickery, these cards come in subsets and allow the use of various magical disguises (or their removal).
items.name: Trickster's Deck

items.description: Rumored to have been created by Maelstrome, the God of Storms and Tempests, this magic item is said to summon powerful winds to aid its owner.
items.name: Horn of Whirlwinds

items.description: A lost magic item from Asturia, the lost colony of the ancient Empire of Macremia; no one knows what is its purpose or function.
items.name: Pearl of Asturia

items.name: Crest of Nys'Raeneen

items.name: Crest of Duur'Nareen

items.name: Crest of Zan'Deezan

items.name: Crest of Raz'Narath

items.name: Crest of Bel'Yraaz

items.description: A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
items.name: Crest of No'Lareen

items.description: A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
items.name: Crest of Meer'Golorh

items.description: A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
items.name: Crest of El'Carlaas

items.description: Created by highpriests of Dianchuur, God of Health and Healing, and blessed by the god himself, this holy item is said to be able to cure any disease.
items.name: Icon of Dianchuur

items.description: An ancient item created by technomages of the lost empire of Telluria. This strange stone allows anyone to speak and understand any mortal language.
items.name: Stone of Tongues

items.description: These incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-platinum coins bear the mintage of the lost empire of Telluria.
items.name: Tellurian Coins

items.description: This incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-silver ceremonial art object was forged long ago by craftmasters of the lost empire of Telluria.
items.name: Tellurian Art Object

items.description: These incredibly ancient and priceless gemstones of various shapes and exquisite designs were crafted by jewelers of the lost empire of Macremia.
items.name: Macremian Gemstones

items.description: This incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-gold lamp was once the possession of a noble house of the lost empire of Macremia.
items.name: Macremian Art Object

items.description: An ancient item which belonged to the legendary Sorcerer-King Khan-Alghuul, it is said to act as a watchful eye for its possessor.
items.name: Eye of Khan-Alghuul

items.description: Created millennia past by macremian technomages, this strange orb will nullify magic and destroy it upon command.
items.name: Arcane Nullifier

items.description: Created hundred of years ago by Hasser the Summoner, the whispy smoke trapped in this bottle is said to animate the shadows.
items.name: Hasser's Summoning Smoke

items.description: Not much is known about this item, nor about its creator; it is said to be able to create storms of fire.
items.name: Krythorach's Fiery Tempest

items.description: A letter bearing the seal of Sharranth. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
items.name: Sharranth Letter

items.description: A letter bearing a seal the likelyness of a skeletal dragon claw covered with dripping blood. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
items.name: Red Claw Letter

items.description: Your typical leather pouch made to hang on a belt and to hold coins. Just click "Use" in order to partake its contents!
items.name: Money Pouch

items.description: Just another seal of officialdom, as often used by monarchs and rulers.
items.name: Seal of Command

items.description: A mystical and magical object of great importance to the Dragonheart Dynasty of Lantharond
items.name: Dragon Orb

items.description: A strange device, this crystal-like stone radiates so much energy that it must be kept in an insulated box of lead.
items.name: Macremian Power Stone
